prompt: A single tower arcology, every floor a different district.

lots.label: arcology tower
lots.brief: One tall tower of stone, glass and iron holding the whole city as stacked district floors, linked by a central stairwell and shafts, with a glass-crowned top.

lots.label: ground-level gatehouse and lobby
lots.brief: Entrance plaza at the tower base leading to the central stairwell.

rules.label: Stacked district floors
rules.notes: Floors stacked in one tower, each its own district with its own palette and lighting, from the ground up.

floors.label: market floor
floors.note: stalls, shops and a tavern ring under lanterns

floors.label: hydroponic farm floor
floors.note: crop beds, water channels, glowstone grow lights

floors.label: temple and garden floor
floors.note: open-air garden and chapel near the top

plan.notes: The district floors live inside the tower; they wait on stacked-floor support.

waits.words: The stacked district floors inside the tower (market to observatory) wait for a later Architect release; the tower and gatehouse are built first.

answer.summary: The Stacked City starts as one huge central tower on the flat ground, with a gatehouse and lobby plaza at its base. The six district floors (market, homes, farm, forge, garden and temple, observatory) are written as a stacked-floors rule. Architect can't build that yet, so it waits while the tower and gatehouse go up.
